data.body: S1 ee8a IMPLEMENTED under held-out TDD. Full oracle (16 test fns / 40 cases) authored and confirmed RED first; only 3 happy-path tests left in tree; implementer never saw the rest. Validation: 37/38 passed on first restore. The ONE failure was a defect in MY test, not the code: monkeypatch.setenv with a NUL raises ValueError 'embedded null byte' — the OS refuses NUL in an env var, so that case was unreachable via ${env:VAR}. Split into an env-indirection arm (CR/LF, the real injection vectors) and a literal-value arm (CR/LF/NUL). MUTATION CHECK: swapping to validate-before-substitute made exactly the 2 injection tests go RED; restoring returned 40 green — the security property is demonstrated, not asserted. CRITICAL CATCH: the implementer had added 16 lines to src/rebar/config.py (a retained _INSTALLED_CLI_OVERRIDES + accessor) to accommodate MY malformed test — I used the flat dotted CLI shape where every existing test uses nested, and installed the override before a reset_config_cache() that DOCUMENTS clearing overrides. Reverted the core change entirely, simplified _cli_raw to read only the passed-in section mapping, and fixed the test to use the nested shape after the reset. Diff now matches declared file_impact exactly. 68 tests green across test_llm_headers/test_config_llm/test_config_cli_overrides.
